description: PROP-AUTH-036 (checkHealth) tests only the success path where the in-memory store is accessible (status 'ok'). There is no test for the failure path (status 'error'). REQ-AUTH-015 requires '503 when DB connection fails'. The checkHealth implementation at shell/index.ts:107-118 has a catch block returning { status: 'error' } but this path is never exercised by any test. The store re-import via dynamic import inside checkHealth makes it nearly impossible for the catch to trigger with the current in-memory implementation, meaning the error path is dead code that cannot be tested without mocking.
